summary: A live-performance firmware built on Optimist: two synth layers on one keyboard plus a drum kit, with a simpler one-page-per-button interface. Most of Optimist's sequencing and sampling is removed.
features: Two layers: LAYER, SPLIT, BLEND crossfade or SINGLE
Engines: PROPHET, DX7-compatible FM6, ANALOG, DIGITAL, JUNO; 12 voices
32 drum kits with a 16-step drum sequencer, 4 to 16 bars
Reverb, chorus and delay sends; master compressor and limiter
External controller knob CCs; Bluetooth MIDI device and host
Saves whole performances; played on one FM-1 so far
